verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs state that it can "automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions" and monitor controls, evidence and personnel, which directly claims event-driven rule automation. The evidence is a single marketing-level line with no detail on how rules are defined or what happens when they fire. The monitoring-test API endpoints show automated control monitoring but not user-defined event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule or trigger definition interface, the supported event types and action types, any API or webhook surface for triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
